definitions.gloss: currently serialized; currently being published in installments
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a manga, novel, or other written work is actively being published in regular installments, as opposed to completed or on hiatus.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連載中|れんさいちゅう}だ。
{連載中|れんさいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I look forward to the serialized novel every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連載中|れんさいちゅう}だ。
examples.english: A popular author is currently serializing a new work in a magazine.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧ (serialization) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during, in the middle of). Used to indicate that a manga, novel, or other written work is currently being published in regular installments. Very common in the publishing and manga/anime world.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載中|れんさいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: currently serialized manga
- {連載中|れんさいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: ongoing serialized work
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{連載中|れんさいちゅう}: currently being serialized
- ⟦{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}→週刊誌：11179_shuukanshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{連載中|れんさいちゅう}: currently serialized in a weekly magazine

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧: serialization — the base noun
- ⟦{連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}→連載終了：24943_rensaishuuryou⟧: end of serialization — when a serial concludes
- {連載開始|れんさいかいし}: start of serialization — when a serial begins
- {休載|きゅうさい}: serialization hiatus — a temporary break in publication
